text: For ten thousand years, one world held the gates of hell shut.
asr: For 10,000 years, one world held the gates of hell shut.

text: Cadia, a fortress world, ringed with ancient pylons.
asr: Kadia, a fortress world, ringed with ancient pylons.

text: Its children were handed rifles before they could walk.
Twelve times, Abaddon the Despoiler led a Black Crusade against it.
asr: Twelve times, a bad in the disboiler led a black crusade against it.

text: On the thirteenth, he brought an ancient star fortress,
asr: On the 13th, he brought an ancient star fortress.

text: and hurled it into the planet.
The pylons shattered. The world split open.
Cadia fell. But its soldiers fought on in the ruins, to the last.
asr: Kadia fell, but its soldiers fought on in the ruins to the last.
